name: jev-ultrafast
description: Drive Chrome from one natural-language goal with Jev Ultrafast: TypeSafe's Jev picks an operation and an element per step, and a small text model writes text only for TYPE_TEXT. Ships setup guidance, run commands, and a dedicated-Chrome launcher. API keys stay in the project's own gitignored .env, never in this plugin.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Jev Ultrafast 让一句话目标驱动真实 Chrome：每一步由 TypeSafe 的 Jev 同时选出操作与元素，只有 TYPE_TEXT 才调用小文本模型。插件含配置说明、运行命令与专属 Chrome 启动脚本；API key 只放在项目自己的 .env（已 gitignore），不进插件。
